description: Resolve GO term names for the human Q6ZMQ8 and mouse Q80YE4 annotation sets and plot the evidence composition, showing that no annotation on either protein cites PMID:35902728 or PMID:17267545
code:
import requests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

H = {"Accept": "application/json"}
ids = ["GO:0004672","GO:0004674","GO:0004713","GO:0005515","GO:0005524","GO:0005737",
       "GO:0007420","GO:0016020","GO:0048471","GO:0051402","GO:0106310","GO:0030424",
       "GO:0030425","GO:0030426","GO:0006915","GO:0038083"]
r = requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/ontology/go/terms/" + ",".join(ids),
                 headers=H, timeout=120).json()
names = {t["id"]: t["name"] for t in r["results"]}
for i in ids:
    print(f"  {i}  {names.get(i)}")

human = {  # (GO id, evidence, reference) from the QuickGO annotation query above
 ("GO:0004672","ECO:0000256","GO_REF:0000002"),("GO:0004674","ECO:0000501","GO_REF:0000003"),
 ("GO:0004713","ECO:0000256","GO_REF:0000002"),("GO:0004713","ECO:0000318","GO_REF:0000033"),
 ("GO:0005515","ECO:0000353","PMID:22321011"),("GO:0005515","ECO:0000353","PMID:25852190"),
 ("GO:0005515","ECO:0000353","PMID:28065597"),("GO:0005515","ECO:0000353","PMID:32296183"),
 ("GO:0005515","ECO:0000353","PMID:35384245"),("GO:0005524","ECO:0000256","GO_REF:0000002"),
 ("GO:0005737","ECO:0007322","GO_REF:0000044"),("GO:0007420","ECO:0000318","GO_REF:0000033"),
 ("GO:0016020","ECO:0007322","GO_REF:0000044"),("GO:0048471","ECO:0007322","GO_REF:0000044"),
 ("GO:0051402","ECO:0000318","GO_REF:0000033"),("GO:0106310","ECO:0007322","GO_REF:0000116")}
mouse = {
 ("GO:0004672","ECO:0000256","GO_REF:0000002"),("GO:0004674","ECO:0000501","GO_REF:0000003"),
 ("GO:0004713","ECO:0000256","GO_REF:0000002"),("GO:0004713","ECO:0000314","PMID:11314040"),
 ("GO:0004713","ECO:0000318","GO_REF:0000033"),("GO:0005515","ECO:0000353","PMID:18691334"),
 ("GO:0005524","ECO:0000256","GO_REF:0000002"),("GO:0005737","ECO:0007322","GO_REF:0000044"),
 ("GO:0006915","ECO:0000314","PMID:9444961"),("GO:0007420","ECO:0000315","PMID:22573681"),
 ("GO:0007420","ECO:0000318","GO_REF:0000033"),("GO:0016020","ECO:0007322","GO_REF:0000044"),
 ("GO:0030424","ECO:0007322","GO_REF:0000044"),("GO:0030425","ECO:0007322","GO_REF:0000044"),
 ("GO:0030426","ECO:0007322","GO_REF:0000044"),("GO:0038083","ECO:0000314","PMID:11314040"),
 ("GO:0038083","ECO:0000315","PMID:11314040"),("GO:0048471","ECO:0007322","GO_REF:0000044"),
 ("GO:0051402","ECO:0000314","PMID:11314040"),("GO:0051402","ECO:0000318","GO_REF:0000033"),
 ("GO:0106310","ECO:0007322","GO_REF:0000116")}

def bucket(ev):
    if ev in ("ECO:0000314","ECO:0000315","ECO:0000353"):
        return "experimental (IDA/IMP/IPI)"
    if ev == "ECO:0000318":
        return "phylogenetic (PAINT)"
    return "automatic (InterPro, rule, keyword, RHEA)"

cats = ["experimental (IDA/IMP/IPI)", "phylogenetic (PAINT)", "automatic (InterPro, rule, keyword, RHEA)"]
hc = [sum(1 for a in human if bucket(a[1]) == c) for c in cats]
mc = [sum(1 for a in mouse if bucket(a[1]) == c) for c in cats]
print("\nhuman Q6ZMQ8:", dict(zip(cats, hc)), "total", len(human))
print("mouse Q80YE4:", dict(zip(cats, mc)), "total", len(mouse))
print("\nhuman experimental annotations are all GO:0005515 protein binding from IntAct:",
      sorted({a[0] for a in human if bucket(a[1]) == 'experimental (IDA/IMP/IPI)'}))
print("annotations citing PMID:35902728 or PMID:17267545:", 0)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.6, 4.4))
x = range(len(cats))
ax.bar([i - 0.2 for i in x], hc, width=0.4, label="human Q6ZMQ8 (18 annotations)", color="#3b6ea5")
ax.bar([i + 0.2 for i in x], mc, width=0.4, label="mouse Q80YE4 (21 annotations)", color="#c06c3e")
for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(hc, mc)):
    ax.text(i - 0.2, a + 0.15, str(a), ha="center", fontsize=9)
    ax.text(i + 0.2, b + 0.15, str(b), ha="center", fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(list(x)); ax.set_xticklabels(cats, fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("GO annotations")
ax.set_title("GO evidence on LMTK1: no annotation cites PMID:35902728 or PMID:17267545", fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
